title: Attribute-Evidence Learning with Multimodal Prompt for Generalized Category Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.12975v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalized category discovery (GCD) aims to discover novel categories from unlabeled data by leveraging limited labeled samples from old classes. Existing methods that rely solely on visual cues often neglect the multimodal nature of human perception, prompting recent approaches to incorporate textual information such as category tags and attributes. However, these approaches typically entangle global tags and local attributes within a shared global image representation, rendering attributes unreliable and potentially providing misleading cues that can drive the model toward incorrect predictions. To this end, we propose AptM-GCD, a novel multimodal framework that exploits apt textual guidance through attribute evidence learning and multimodal prompt reasoning. Specifically, we design an Attribute-Evidence Learning (AEL) mechanism that treats attributes as localized visual evidence rather than global category descriptors. By interacti

translated_title: 基于多模态提示的属性-证据学习用于广义类别发现
translated_abstract: 广义类别发现旨在通过利用来自旧类别的有限标注样本，从未标注数据中发现新类别。现有仅依赖视觉线索的方法往往忽视了人类感知的多模态特性，这促使近期的方法引入诸如类别标签和属性等文本信息。然而，这些方法通常将全局标签和局部属性纠缠在共享的全局图像表示中，导致属性变得不可靠，并可能提供误导性线索，从而驱使模型做出错误的预测。为此，我们提出了 AptM-GCD，一种新颖的多模态框架，它通过属性证据学习和多模态提示推理来利用恰当的文本引导。具体而言，我们设计了一种属性-证据学习机制，将属性视为局部化的视觉证据而非全局类别描述符。通过交互……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 AptM-GCD 多模态框架，通过属性-证据学习机制将属性作为局部视觉证据而非全局类别描述符，并结合多模态提示推理，避免了文本与全局图像表示纠缠导致的误导性预测，从而更准确地发现新类别。
en_tdlr: Proposes AptM-GCD, a multimodal framework that treats attributes as localized visual evidence through Attribute-Evidence Learning and multimodal prompt reasoning, avoiding misleading cues caused by entangling text with global image representations for more accurate novel category discovery.
